11.3
R. Statham Motion Three (3) - Development Charges: Implementation History and Financial Impact
Recommendation:
That West Elgin Council direct the Treasurer, in consultation with the CAO, to prepare and present a written report outlining the history and implementation of the Municipality's Development Charges By-law 2024-85; And
That the report shall include:
A brief chronology of the development charges process, including completion of the background study, Council's approval of the by-law on December 19, 2024, its effective date, and the subsequent establishment of the required development charge reserve funds.
An explanation of the timeline between the by-law taking effect and the implementation of development charge collection, including the circumstances that contributed to any delays and when the issue was identified.
A summary of the steps taken by the current administration to address the delay, establish the required reserve funds and implement development charge collection.
An assessment of the financial impact of the delay, including an estimate of development charges that may have been payable during the period in which charges were not being collected, distinguishing between amounts that were potentially eligible, exempt, deferred, waived or otherwise not collectible.
The total development charges collected since implementation, broken down by year and applicable service category, together with the current balances of the associated reserve funds.
Identification of any outstanding development charge obligations, unrecovered amounts or other financial implications arising from the implementation delay, and any further steps required to address them;
And further that the report be prepared using existing municipal records and presented to Council within 60 calendar days.
